title: Distillation-ready labelling: distill lint, labelling rule, shipped-but-open report
goal: Make labelled, scoped, closed task records the standard workflow so the next release can be assembled from records: add `distill lint` (commits without Task: trailers, tasks landed but still open, commits outside declared scopes), document the rule in AGENTS.md and docs/distillation.md, locate the `tasks close` field loss, and report shipped-but-still-open records for owners without editing them.
acceptance: distill lint --range origin/main --base origin/main (real run, deterministic across 3 runs)

claim.tool: susi-commercial tasks claim (built from susi-commercial-apps origin/main 87cac0f)
claim.note: First attempt refused because the worktree was 3 commits behind origin/main; fast-forwarded to eba6c9fba and the claim succeeded. The closed T-GROKDISTILL-1 claim (overlapping xtask/src/distill.rs, docs/distillation.md) did not block.

base_note: Started from 222f83a1a; fast-forwarded to eba6c9fba before claiming.

results.unit_tests: 19/19 passed (8 new lint tests + 11 existing planner tests), cargo test --offline --locked -p xtask --bin distill
results.clippy: clean, cargo clippy --offline --locked -p xtask --bin distill --all-targets -- -D warnings
results.tasks_close_field_loss: Owned by Susi Commercial Apps, crates/susi-dev-workflow/src/admin/tasks.rs: struct Task has no catch-all field, so close re-serialises only id,title,goal,size,deps,accept,created_by,created_unix,closed. Not fixed here; noted for the commercial workstream (fix: #[serde(flatten)] extra map plus a close round-trip test).
results.publisher_integration: Not done by design: local-snapshot/git_publish.rs (Dot, T-DOTGITPUBLISHER-1) untouched. The rule is documented and `distill lint --range origin/main..HEAD --strict` is the advisory pre-publish check.

limitations: Lint is advisory; nothing on main enforces it (Mandate 73: no mandatory main gate).
Scope fallback uses this clone's refs/claims; other clones may differ.
Most historical closed records have no scopes (never declared, or dropped by tasks close), so full-history tasks_without_scopes is large (1387).
The tasks close field loss remains until the commercial fix lands; this task's own done/ record will lose these fields when closed (full record stays in history).
Shipped-but-open records were reported, not edited; some may legitimately have more work to come.
